Adee & Lester

3035 White Plains Road, Bronx, NY 10467

Built in 2009 | 74 units
2-bedroom unit (1 available)

Adee & Lester Apartments, located in the Morris Park Section of the Bronx at 3035 White Plains Road between Adee Avenue and Lester Street, consists of 74 units of affordable housing and approximately 11,000 s/f of commercial retail space. There are also on-site parking spaces for tenant usage. All units in the project are set aside for households earning no more than 55% of the AMI.
